notes.title: Patch Update 5.6
notes.notes:
Various Fixes :

[olist]
[*] Settings and Mode Selection
[*] Weapon damage balance
[*] Collider Issues
[*] Soldier spawning glitches
[*] Timer bug
[*] Fieldgun and grenadier bug
[*] Sniper damage
[/olist]

notes.title: Update: New Input Manager and Custom Keybinding, UI upgrades
notes.notes:
Patch Log:
[list]
[*] Control key bindings can be remapped from settings
[*] Bug in Unity's Input Manager, Implement new input manager.
[*] Previously it was unclear when the group is selected only 1 soldier has a diamond above its head. Now group selection has markers over each head.
[*] Pathfinding bugs
[*] Easier to move a large group of soldiers. 
[*] Bombzone animation
[*] In the tutorial, you can click on the dialogue box instead of the triangle.
[/list]

Please let us know if you have any feedback, suggestions or bugs and we'll be sure to read everything and do everything we can to develop this game into something great that you will all enjoy!

notes.title: Hotfix: Camera Edge detection issue
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, the first update for Warfront Defenders: Westerplatte is here!

Patch Log:
Fixed an issue of camera scrolling off screen due to edge detection. 
In future builds, the edge detection will be optional and configurable.

Thanks for playing and if you have any feedback/bug reports please don't hesitate to let me know!
